comments: It seems they were not critical errors, but `DPANIC` sounds terrible.

This is caused by https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/30084

The issue is that it was only ever a noop / it's not safe to noop for some applications.

> This is caused by #30084

caused by https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/36640

this var is set to `readonly` in 5.4, but the check added in current master

review_comments: We'd better not set `lc_time_names`. Otherwise, there are still many unnecessary logs.
as explained in comments, not sure whether tidb will support it in later release
Can we reduce duplicate logs? In my test, importing 7G data will print 304 line logs like this.
